request.project_task: Create a parcel tracking and delivery confirmation service.
request.project_goal: Give senders and recipients a reliable parcel status.
request.project_description: Carrier events update parcel status; the recipient confirms delivery or reports a problem.

functional_requirements.text: A sender creates a shipment with recipient details.

atoms.text: A sender creates a shipment with recipient details.

functional_requirements.text: A carrier posts parcel scan events.

atoms.text: A carrier posts parcel scan events.

functional_requirements.text: The system derives the current parcel status from accepted events.

atoms.text: The system derives the current parcel status from accepted events.

functional_requirements.text: A recipient views the current status.

atoms.text: A recipient views the current status.

functional_requirements.text: A recipient confirms delivery or reports damage.

atoms.text: A recipient confirms delivery or reports damage.

non_functional_requirements.text: Duplicate carrier events must be idempotent.
Tracking history must be retained for one year.

actors.name: Recipient
actors.description: Views parcel status and confirms delivery or reports damage.

use_cases.name: Create Shipment
use_cases.goal: A sender creates a shipment with recipient details.

success_postconditions.text: Shipment is created with recipient details.

user_stories.capability: create a shipment with recipient details
user_stories.benefit: I can send parcels to recipients.

system_stories.system_action: Validate recipient details and create shipment record.
system_stories.responsibility: Ensure shipment is created with valid recipient details.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-001 — Create Shipment
Goal: A sender creates a shipment with recipient details.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: Sender initiates shipment creation.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC001-001: Sender is authenticated.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC001-001] Sender provides recipient details.
  2. [STEP-UC001-002] Sender submits shipment creation request.
Source FRs: FR-001

use_cases.name: Post Parcel Scan Event
use_cases.goal: A carrier posts parcel scan events.

success_postconditions.text: Parcel scan event is accepted and stored.

steps.action: Carrier posts a parcel scan event.
Carrier posts a duplicate parcel scan event.

system_stories.system_action: Validate and store parcel scan events, ensuring idempotency.
system_stories.responsibility: Accept and persist parcel scan events without duplicates.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-002 — Post Parcel Scan Event
Goal: A carrier posts parcel scan events.
Primary actor: ACT-002
Trigger: Carrier scans a parcel.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC002-001: Carrier is authenticated.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC002-001] Carrier posts a parcel scan event.
  2. [STEP-UC002-002] System stores the accepted event.
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC002-EXC-001: Duplicate Event
Source FRs: FR-002

use_cases.name: Derive Parcel Status
use_cases.goal: The system derives the current parcel status from accepted events.
use_cases.trigger: New parcel scan event is accepted.

preconditions.text: At least one parcel scan event exists.

failure_postconditions.text: Current parcel status is not updated.

steps.action: System retrieves accepted events for the parcel.
System derives current status from events.

user_stories.capability: derive current parcel status from accepted events

system_stories.system_action: Derive and update parcel status based on accepted events.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-003 — Derive Parcel Status
Goal: The system derives the current parcel status from accepted events.
Primary actor: ACT-002
Trigger: New parcel scan event is accepted.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC003-001: At least one parcel scan event exists.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC003-001] System retrieves accepted events for the parcel.
  2. [STEP-UC003-002] System derives current status from events.
  3. [STEP-UC003-003] System updates the parcel status.
Source FRs: FR-003

use_cases.name: View Parcel Status
use_cases.goal: A recipient views the current status.

steps.action: System retrieves and displays current status.

user_stories.benefit: I know where my parcel is.

system_stories.system_action: Retrieve and display current parcel status.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-004 — View Parcel Status
Goal: A recipient views the current status.
Primary actor: ACT-003
Trigger: Recipient requests parcel status.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC004-001: Recipient is authenticated.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC004-001] Recipient requests parcel status.
  2. [STEP-UC004-002] System retrieves and displays current status.
Source FRs: FR-004

use_cases.name: Confirm Delivery or Report Damage
use_cases.goal: A recipient confirms delivery or reports damage.

success_postconditions.text: Delivery is confirmed or damage is reported.

failure_postconditions.text: Confirmation or report is not recorded.

user_stories.benefit: I can inform the sender about the parcel condition.

system_stories.system_action: Record delivery confirmation or damage report.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-005 — Confirm Delivery or Report Damage
Goal: A recipient confirms delivery or reports damage.
Primary actor: ACT-003
Trigger: Recipient receives parcel.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC005-001: Recipient is authenticated.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC005-001] Recipient confirms delivery.
Alternative scenarios:
  - SCN-UC005-ALT-001: Report Damage
Source FRs: FR-005
